categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Modifies PSBT input signing and verification logic in src/psbt.cpp, which forms core wallet PSBT handling.
categories.rationale: Fixes a PSBT signing and finalization failure where `SignPSBTInput` erroneously rejects valid 65-byte Taproot `SIGHASH_ALL` signatures when `PSBT_IN_SIGHASH_TYPE` is unset (issue #36507). Resolving this prevents transactions from failing to be signed further or finalized during multi-party or multi-signer Taproot workflows.
